'''Karam''' is a minor [[Andoran]] lord loyal to [[House Sarand]].

== Appearance ==
He has a lean face and large lips.

== History ==
He has been friends with Lord [[Jarid Sarand]] since childhood.

==Activities==
Karam is stationed with Jarid's army on the road to [[Whitebridge]] when they are hit by a [[bubble of evil]] that turns all metal soft. Troubled by Jarid's increasing fervor to try and kill [[Elayne Trakand]], Karam and the rest of the men abandon Jarid and march for the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]].
== Trivia ==
* Karam is named for Steven Karam, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
